thread:
incident-bot: Pager — high queue growth in gcp-ap-south1 GPU pool. Autoscaler is issuing scale-up, but nodes are failing with QUOTA_DENIED from GCP (GPUS_NVIDIA_T4). Affected routing: inference-gpu-pool/ap-south1, several requests returning 503. Paging @oncall.

olivia_sre: ack, on it. Can someone paste the last node-provision logs?

jane_eng: seeing the same. k8s events show: FailedCreate: quotaExceeded, cloud provider returned 403. Linking logs.

jane_eng: ```
I0612 14:03:12 kubelet.go:123] Requesting 4 x nvidia-t4 per node
E0612 14:03:13 compute.go:456] API error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Quota 'GPUS_NVIDIA_T4' exceeded for project 123456789 (more info: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas)
```

olivia_sre: ok quota hit. Is this regional (ap-south1) or project-wide?

jane_eng: appears regional for that sku. Project quota for ap-south1 T4 is 0 remaining. We have warm pools in eu-west1 and us-central1 with spare capacity.

mike_prod: customer impact? I have a ticket from a big tenant reporting increased latency and timeouts ~14:02 UTC.

raj_sales: confirmed — one enterprise customer saw ~15% error rate on embeddings and flagged CSM. They want ETA.

olivia_sre: ETA depends — if quota increase from GCP, might be hours. Need mitigation path: 1) reroute non-SLA traffic to eu-west1 warm pool 2) drop batch size / fall back to cpu variant for low-priority jobs 3) enable temporary model-quantized variant to reduce GPU need.

jane_eng: I can push a routing policy change to send 40% of inference traffic to eu-west1 for non-dedicated customers (no config change from customers). Proposed patch:

```yaml
routes:
  - name: ap-south1-default
    match: headers.x-customer-tier == "standard"
    weight: 60
    region: ap-south1
  - name: ap-south1-fallback
    match: headers.x-customer-tier == "standard"
    weight: 40
    region: eu-west1
```

jane_eng: applying now. Deploying routing change (canary 5% -> 40%).

deploy-bot: deploy started by jane_eng for config routes v2024-06-12-canary

olivia_sre: also change autoscaler fallback policy to prefer smaller GPU instance types (T4 -> T4-quantized variant) so we reduce units requested. Adding a temporary rule to prefer existing warm nodes.

jane_eng: done. Also setting inference batch-size override for low-priority to 1 to reduce queue hold.

olivia_sre: Can someone run `gcloud compute regions describe ap-south1 --project=infra-redwood` and check quota?

jane_eng: pasted output:```
quotas:
 - metric: "GPUS_TESLA_T4"
   limit: 16
   usage: 16
 - metric: "CPUS"
   limit: 800
   usage: 420
```

olivia_sre: yep limit hit. Submitted increase request (case 987654321). Will follow up with GCP support.

mike_prod: traffic split live? Any visible improvement?

jane_eng: queue length on inference-gpu-pool down from 420 -> 150 in last 10m since we started split and batch-size override. Error rate down from 12% -> 3%.

incident-bot: Update: queue length reduced 64% in 12m. Autoscaler still reporting pending since cloud denies new GPUs, but existing warm instances handling traffic.

raj_sales: I'll send a short note to the impacted customer: acknowledge degraded service, mitigation in place (reroute + lower batch size), ETA for full resolution pending quota increase. Drafting now.

olivia_sre: temporary mitigation accepted. Next actions: a) keep routing canary at 40% for 1 hour and monitor b) escalate GCP quota increase case c) runbook follow-up to ensure warm pool sizing prevents single-region saturation. I'll own the postmortem.

jane_eng: FYI, we also validated cross-cloud path to AWS ap-south-1 warm pool; that's a fallback if GCP quota isn't raised. Preparing runbook steps but not switching unless necessary.

deploy-bot: canary update: routing v2024-06-12-canary -> 40% applied (5 -> 40).

olivia_sre: good job. Once queue stabilizes <50 and error rate <1% we'll close. Keep me posted every 15m. :thumbsup:

mike_prod: observed sustained improvement. Will update ops channel.

jane_eng: adding follow-up tickets: INFRA-612 (warm pool autosizing), RUNBOOK-88 (cross-region fallback steps), PM-449 (customer comm).

incident-bot: Pager resolved for now — mitigation active and traffic rerouted; monitoring continues.

olivia_sre: closing this thread when stable. Postmortem owner: olivia_sre. Customer comm owner: raj_sales.

raj_sales: sent CS note and copied ops changes.

olivia_sre: final note: quota increase request submitted, but do not rely on that. We'll schedule warm pool increase for ap-south1 in next maintenance window.

mike_prod: thanks everyone.

jane_eng: nice teamwork. :rocket:
